profile.description:
OpenAI's tts-1-hd model, brought to Poe as a server bot! This model speaks the text in the latest message and outputs audio. Learn more at https://platform.openai.com/docs/models/tts-1-hd.

Optional parameters:
- voice: the name of the voice to use: "alloy", "ash", "coral", "echo", "fable", "nova", "onyx", "sage", or "shimmer" (default: sage)
- speed: the multiplier for how fast you want the audio to be. Ranges from 0.25x to 4x
- response_format: the file format of the generated audio

This bot has higher quality output than https://poe.com/OpenAI-TTS-1, but it is also more expensive.
profile.poweredBy: Powered by a server managed by @binaai.
